caseName: In re Disbarment of Bong Hyun Kim
caseNameFull: In re Disbarment of Bong Hyun Kim

opinions.text: It is ordered that Bong Hyun Kim, of Chicago, Ill., be suspended from the practice of law in this Court and that a rule issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
